description: This source file defines the AzureQueueStreamProviderBuilder class responsible for configuring Azure Queue Streaming in Orleans. It includes methods to set up stream providers with queue options based on configuration sections, supporting both silo and client builders.

classes.name: AzureQueueStreamProviderBuilder
classes.description: A sealed class implementing IProviderBuilder for ISiloBuilder and IClientBuilder to configure Azure Queue streaming based on provided configuration sections.

methods.name: Configure (ISiloBuilder)
methods.description: Configures the silo builder to add Azure Queue streams with options derived from configuration.

methods.name: Configure (IClientBuilder)
methods.description: Configures the client builder to add Azure Queue streams with options derived from configuration.

methods.name: GetQueueOptionBuilder
methods.description: Creates an options configuration delegate for AzureQueueOptions, setting properties based on the configuration section, such as QueueNames, MessageVisibilityTimeout, and QueueServiceClient.
